english.title: Possess a comic tending to corrupt children / young persons for purpose of sale or hire

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Children and Young Persons Harmful Publications Act 1955

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) had a work in your possession to which the Children and Young Persons (Harmful Publications) Act 1955 applied, namely **(..SPECIFY PUBLICATION..), for the purpose of selling it or letting it on hire
english.legislation: Contrary to section 2 of the Children and Young Persons (Harmful Publications) Act 1955.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
possess for purpose of sale or let for hire a book / magazine / other like work
which was of a kind
likely to fall into hands of
children / young persons
consisted wholly / mainly of stories told in pictures
being stories portraying the commission of
crimes / acts of violence / cruelty /
incidents of a repulsive / horrible nature
in such way that the work as a whole
would tend to corrupt a child / young person
into whose hands it might fall

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
